newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Argentina gets tough with Brazil banks - paper.
newsitem.headline: Argentina gets tough with Brazil banks - paper.

text.p: The Argentine government has toughened its until-now flexible stance towards Brazilian banks opening offices in Argentina, saying now only those strictly meeting all legal requirements may do so, a local newspaper said.

Gazeta Mercantil said Buenos Aires, which has been lenient with Brazilian banks moving to Argentina, has repeatedly asked Brasilia to adopt an equally open policy but received only unmet promises of reciprocity.
The paper quoted an unnamed Argentine official as saying Brazilian bank Banco Itau's recent opening of an office in Buenos Aires was "our last show of love for Brazil."
It will now require all Brazilian banks looking to install offices in Argentina to meet all legal requirements, including creation of a risk center, the paper said.
Gazeta quoted unnamed Brazilian Central Bank officials as promising to respond concretely to the Argentine complaints in 15 days.
